attacks.name: Darkforce Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This character may reroll all of the attack dice for this attack.

attacks.name: Rending Force
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Dimensional Portal
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 3 and place it within |!range| 3 of its current position. A character can be placed by this superpower only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Darkforce Barrier
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, this character may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to the defense roll against that attack. This character or the allied character cannot be advanced, pushed, or placed by the effects of that attack.
